summary: community.vmware added vmware_vasa to register or unregister VASA providers and vmware_vasa_info to gather information about them.
questions: How do I register a VASA provider with Ansible?
Is there a module to list VASA providers?

answer_card.title: community.vmware VASA provider modules
answer_card.answer_md: New in community.vmware: **`vmware_vasa`** (register/unregister a VASA provider) and **`vmware_vasa_info`** (list existing providers).
